per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: OpenCode TUI, or any client pointed at the published endpoint
chaining: the only plan found in this topic that publishes both a per-model dollar ceiling and the API endpoint that spends it

limits.value: per-model monthly dollar ceiling; the 5-hour cap is 20 per cent of it, the weekly cap 50 per cent, the month 100 per cent

no per-request limit is published. The page publishes an estimated request count per model and names the token shape each estimate assumes, for example GLM-5.3/5.2 at 700 input, 52,000 cached and 150 output tokens per request, under 'The estimates use the following token counts per request; actual usage varies'

free_tier.stated: Go is USD 10 a month and Go Plus USD 40; three models are Free with an Unlimited monthly limit 'limited time', and free models stay usable after the paid limit is reached
free_tier.notes: the paid limit is a monthly dollar amount per model, not a token count

interface_detail: an API key from the OpenCode console; endpoints are published per model family at opencode.ai/inference/go/{openai,anthropic,google}/

identity_cost.detail: billing details and a card in the console; one seat per workspace, and a workspace with a Go subscription cannot invite members

confidence_note: the ceilings, the reset windows and the endpoints are quoted from the vendor page read today. The dollar ceiling has not been converted to tokens by measurement. verified_at is the instant its evidence URLs were fetched on 2026-10-22, read from the fetch log, not typed.

evidence.proved: Go USD 10 a month and Go Plus USD 40; usage limits are monthly dollar amounts per model, with 5-hour, weekly and monthly allowances at 20, 50 and 100 per cent; 16 of the 36 Go ceilings are USD 15, 13 are USD 60, two are USD 30, two are USD 80 and three are Unlimited; the page publishes estimated request counts per model against a named token shape and states no per-request limit; exceeded limits fall back to pay-as-you-go credit if enabled, otherwise requests are blocked and the free models remain usable
the pay-as-you-go Console prices 14 model ids at Free for input, output and cached read, all marked Free or limited time

notes: The GLM-5.3 cap of USD 15 a month at USD 1.40 per 1M input is about 10.7M input tokens with no output.
